subject: RFQ: STM32 and 0603 capacitors
body:
Hello,

We are building a pilot batch of controller boards and need a quote for:
- 500 pcs STM32F407VGT6
- 2000 pcs 100nF 0603 X7R capacitors

Please deliver to our site in Serbia. We need the goods by November 20, 2026.

Kind regards,
Paul Hughes
BrightLabs

body:

Zlatibor Hotel
